```{ojs}
//| output: false
{
  [periodPolar_controls, periodPolar_data, globalScopeInfo, globalAdmin1, cbMode, width];
  renderToDiv("plotPeriodPolar", () => {
  const { variable, valueMode } = periodPolar_controls;
  const isRawMode = valueMode === "raw";
  const meanCol   = isRawMode ? "mean" : "mean_anomaly";
  const { scope, isCountry } = globalScopeInfo;
  const isPTOT = variable === "PTOT";
  const unit   = isPTOT ? "mm" : "°C";
  const sspLabels = { ssp126:"SSP1-2.6", ssp245:"SSP2-4.5", ssp370:"SSP3-7.0", ssp585:"SSP5-8.5" };
  // Canonical SSP order (low→high emissions).
  const sspOrder = ["ssp126","ssp245","ssp370","ssp585"];
  const ssps     = sspOrder.filter(s => (periodPolar_controls.ssp ?? []).includes(s));
  const sspsForRender = ssps.length ? ssps : ["ssp245"];

  if (!periodPolar_data.length) return htl.html`<p style="color:#888;font-style:italic;padding:12px 0;">
    ⏳ Fetching CMIP6 parquets (shared cache — may take 15–30 s on first scroll into Future Projections)…
  </p>`;

  // Row policy: if user picked admin1s in the global popup, render up to
  // MAX_ROWS facets (alphabetical). Otherwise render one scope-mean row.
  const MAX_ROWS = 6;
  const selAdmin1All = isCountry ? (globalAdmin1 ?? []) : [];
  const overflow     = Math.max(0, selAdmin1All.length - MAX_ROWS);
  const rowAdmin1s   = [...selAdmin1All].sort().slice(0, MAX_ROWS);
  // Each row is either an admin1 name or null (= scope mean across all
  // admin1s in scope). Default to a single scope-mean row when no admin1
  // selection is active.
  const rows = rowAdmin1s.length > 0
    ? rowAdmin1s.map(a => ({ label: a,            admin1: a   }))
    : [{                         label: "All admin1s", admin1: null }];

  // Rolling 3-month season layout. Each wedge centred on its middle
  // month — DJF at 12 o'clock (centred on Jan), JFM at 1 o'clock
  // (Feb), …, NDJ at 11 o'clock (Dec). Labels show the season CODE
  // (JFM / FMA / …) per Pete's preference over month abbreviations.
  const seasonsClock = [
    { key: "DJF", centerMonth: 0 },
    { key: "JFM", centerMonth: 1 },
    { key: "FMA", centerMonth: 2 },
    { key: "MAM", centerMonth: 3 },
    { key: "AMJ", centerMonth: 4 },
    { key: "MJJ", centerMonth: 5 },
    { key: "JJA", centerMonth: 6 },
    { key: "JAS", centerMonth: 7 },
    { key: "ASO", centerMonth: 8 },
    { key: "SON", centerMonth: 9 },
    { key: "OND", centerMonth: 10 },
    { key: "NDJ", centerMonth: 11 },
  ];
  const ringPeriods = ["1995-2014","2021-2040","2041-2060","2061-2080","2081-2100"];

  // Aggregate one bucket per (rowKey, ssp, period, season). rowKey =
  // admin1 name for per-admin1 rows, "__scope__" for the scope-mean row.
  const SCOPE = "__scope__";
  const aggMap = new Map();
  const rowKeys = new Set(rows.map(r => r.admin1));
  const wantsScopeMean = rows.some(r => r.admin1 === null);
  for (const d of periodPolar_data) {
    const v = Number(d[meanCol]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(v)) continue;
    const sc = d.period === "1995-2014" ? "historical" : d.scenario;
    // Per-admin1 row.
    if (rowKeys.has(d.admin1_name)) {
      const k = `${d.admin1_name}|${sc}|${d.period}|${d.season}`;
      if (!aggMap.has(k)) aggMap.set(k, { sum: 0, n: 0 });
      const e = aggMap.get(k); e.sum += v; e.n += 1;
    }
    // Scope-mean row (always also accumulates the data when needed).
    if (wantsScopeMean) {
      const k = `${SCOPE}|${sc}|${d.period}|${d.season}`;
      if (!aggMap.has(k)) aggMap.set(k, { sum: 0, n: 0 });
      const e = aggMap.get(k); e.sum += v; e.n += 1;
    }
  }
  const cellOf = (rowKey, ssp, period, season) => {
    const scKey = period === "1995-2014" ? "historical" : ssp;
    const e = aggMap.get(`${rowKey ?? SCOPE}|${scKey}|${period}|${season}`);
    if (!e || !e.n) return null;
    return e.sum / e.n;
  };

  // --- Palette ----------------------------------------------------
  // Anomaly mode: diverging blue→red (RdBu reversed so positive = red).
  // Symmetric domain around 0; same convention as observational P4.
  // Raw mode: sequential Inferno (matches observational P4 raw view).
  // Both modes derive the domain from the visible-future-cells max.
  const SCALE_FLOOR = {
    TAVG: 2.0, TMAX: 2.5, TMIN: 2.5, PTOT: 100,
    NTx35: 15, NTx40: 15, NDWS: 30, NDWL0: 15,
    "THI-max": 5, "HSH-max": 100,
  };
  // Collect visible-future-cell values across every (row, ssp) pairing
  // so the palette domain is shared across the whole grid (cross-cell
  // comparison is the whole point of the small-multiples layout).
  const futureRingPeriods = ringPeriods.filter(p => p !== "1995-2014");
  const visibleVals = [];
  for (const row of rows) for (const ssp of sspsForRender)
    for (const p of futureRingPeriods) for (const s of seasonsClock) {
      const v = cellOf(row.admin1, ssp, p, s.key);
      if (Number.isFinite(v)) visibleVals.push(v);
    }
  const dataMax = Math.max(0, ...visibleVals.map(Math.abs));
  const floor   = SCALE_FLOOR[variable] ?? 1;
  const scaleMax = Math.max(dataMax, floor);
  // Anomaly palette domain symmetric (Pete's directive: always blue-to-red
  // diverging when in anomaly view, even if PTOT-style data is one-signed).
  const anomDomLo = -scaleMax, anomDomHi = scaleMax;
  const rawDomLo = visibleVals.length ? Math.min(...visibleVals) : 0;
  const rawDomHi = visibleVals.length ? Math.max(...visibleVals) : 1;
  const domLo = isRawMode ? rawDomLo : anomDomLo;
  const domHi = isRawMode ? rawDomHi : anomDomHi;
  // Variable-aware palette so PTOT (and other wet-vs-dry variables in
  // the future) honours the **hot = dry / cool = wet** convention Pete
  // standardised across the notebook. Temperature stays warm-for-warm.
  //   Anomaly:
  //     - Temp: RdBu reversed → positive = red (warming).
  //     - PTOT: BrBG (brown → teal) → positive = teal (wetter / cool),
  //             negative = brown (drier / warm).
  //   Raw (sequential):
  //     - Temp: Inferno (low = dark / cool, high = yellow / hot).
  //     - PTOT: RdYlBu (low = red / dry / hot, high = blue / wet / cool).
  const colourFn = isRawMode
    ? (v => {
        if (v == null || !Number.isFinite(v)) return "#eee";
        const t = (v - rawDomLo) / (rawDomHi - rawDomLo || 1);
        if (isPTOT) {
          // RdYlBu: t=0 → red (dry), t=1 → blue (wet). Already in the
          // right direction. PuBu used in CB mode to keep blue=wet.
          return cbMode ? d3.interpolatePuBu(0.05 + 0.9 * t) : d3.interpolateRdYlBu(t);
        }
        return cbMode ? d3.interpolatePlasma(0.1 + 0.8 * t)
                      : d3.interpolateInferno(0.05 + 0.9 * t);
      })
    : (v => {
        if (v == null || !Number.isFinite(v)) return "#eee";
        if (isPTOT) {
          // BrBG: t=0 → brown (dry), t=0.5 → white (no change), t=1 → teal (wet).
          // Map positive anomaly → teal end → cool. PuOr in CB mode.
          const t = 0.5 + v / (scaleMax * 2.2);
          return cbMode ? d3.interpolatePuOr(1 - t) : d3.interpolateBrBG(t);
        }
        // Temperature anomaly — RdBu reversed (positive = red = warm).
        const t = 0.5 - v / (scaleMax * 2.2);
        return cbMode ? d3.interpolatePuOr(t) : d3.interpolateRdBu(t);
      });

  // --- Geometry ---------------------------------------------------
  // Each cell = polar clock subplot. Cell width derived from available
  // grid width; row labels take fixed left-margin; col header bar takes
  // top space.
  const nCols    = sspsForRender.length;
  const nRows    = rows.length;
  const leftLab  = 60;
  const topLab   = 26;
  const titleH   = 22;
  const cellGap  = 10;
  const cellW    = Math.max(220, Math.floor((width - leftLab - (nCols - 1) * cellGap) / nCols));
  const cellH    = cellW + 26;  // +space for the season-code rim labels at bottom
  const ringW    = Math.floor((cellW / 2 - 50) / ringPeriods.length);
  const r0       = Math.max(18, Math.floor(cellW * 0.06));   // central hub
  const rOuter   = r0 + ringPeriods.length * ringW;
  const arc      = d3.arc().padAngle(0.005).cornerRadius(1);
  const wedgeSpan = (2 * Math.PI) / 12;
  const totalW   = leftLab + nCols * cellW + (nCols - 1) * cellGap + 12;
  const legendH  = 90;  // colour ramp (56) + ring-period legend strip (34)
  const totalH   = titleH + topLab + nRows * cellH + (nRows - 1) * cellGap + legendH + 12;

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${totalW} ${totalH}`)
    .attr("width", totalW).attr("height", totalH)
    .style("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif")
    .style("max-width", "100%").style("height", "auto")
    .attr("id", `plotPeriodPolarSvg`);

  // Top-level title.
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", totalW / 2).attr("y", 16)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", 12).attr("font-weight", 600).attr("fill", "#222")
    .text(`${scope} · ${variable} · ${isRawMode ? "raw value" : "anomaly vs 1995–2014"} (${unit})`);

  // Column headers (SSP labels).
  sspsForRender.forEach((s, ci) => {
    const cx = leftLab + ci * (cellW + cellGap) + cellW / 2;
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", cx).attr("y", titleH + topLab - 8)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("font-size", 11).attr("font-weight", 700).attr("fill", "#222")
      .text(sspLabels[s] ?? s);
  });

  // Show row labels only when there's an actual admin1 facet split
  // (multiple rows OR a single user-picked admin1). The default
  // scope-mean row hides its label — "All admin1s" was getting clipped
  // and overlapping with the leftmost wedge labels.
  const showRowLabels = !(rows.length === 1 && rows[0].admin1 === null);

  // Build each (row, col) polar clock.
  rows.forEach((row, ri) => {
    const cyRow = titleH + topLab + ri * (cellH + cellGap) + cellH / 2;
    // Row label on the left.
    if (showRowLabels) svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", leftLab - 8).attr("y", cyRow)
      .attr("text-anchor", "end").attr("dominant-baseline", "middle")
      .attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", 600).attr("fill", "#222")
      .text(row.label);
    sspsForRender.forEach((ssp, ci) => {
      const cxCell = leftLab + ci * (cellW + cellGap) + cellW / 2;
      const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${cxCell}, ${cyRow})`);
      // Wedges.
      ringPeriods.forEach((period, ringIdx) => {
        const innerR = r0 + ringIdx * ringW;
        const outerR = innerR + ringW;
        seasonsClock.forEach(s => {
          const v = cellOf(row.admin1, ssp, period, s.key);
          const centreAngle = (s.centerMonth / 12) * 2 * Math.PI;
          const startA = centreAngle - wedgeSpan / 2;
          const endA   = centreAngle + wedgeSpan / 2;
          g.append("path")
            .attr("d", arc({ innerRadius: innerR, outerRadius: outerR, startAngle: startA, endAngle: endA }))
            .attr("fill", colourFn(v))
            .attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
            .append("title")
            .text(`${row.label} · ${sspLabels[ssp] ?? ssp} · ${period} · ${s.key}\n${v != null ? v.toFixed(2) + " " + unit : "no data"}`);
        });
      });
      // Season-code rim labels (12 labels, one per wedge centre).
      seasonsClock.forEach(s => {
        const angle = (s.centerMonth / 12) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
        const lr = rOuter + 14;
        g.append("text")
          .attr("x", Math.cos(angle) * lr).attr("y", Math.sin(angle) * lr)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("dominant-baseline", "middle")
          .attr("font-size", 9).attr("font-weight", 500).attr("fill", "#444")
          .text(s.key);
      });
      // Period labels removed from inside the clock — when the grid has
      // multiple columns the per-ring text becomes unreadable at typical
      // cell sizes. Ring → period mapping is rendered as a separate
      // legend strip below the colour-ramp legend.
    });
  });

  // Shared colour-ramp legend (bottom).
  const rampW = Math.min(420, totalW - 80);
  const rampH = 10;
  const legendY = titleH + topLab + nRows * cellH + (nRows - 1) * cellGap + 22;
  const legendG = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${(totalW - rampW) / 2}, ${legendY})`);
  const rampId  = `polar-ramp-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
  const grad    = legendG.append("defs").append("linearGradient").attr("id", rampId)
    .attr("x1","0%").attr("x2","100%");
  const nStops = 32;
  for (let i = 0; i <= nStops; i++) {
    const t = i / nStops;
    const v = domLo + t * (domHi - domLo);
    grad.append("stop").attr("offset", `${t * 100}%`).attr("stop-color", colourFn(v));
  }
  legendG.append("rect")
    .attr("x", 0).attr("y", 0).attr("width", rampW).attr("height", rampH)
    .attr("fill", `url(#${rampId})`).attr("stroke", "#888").attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
  const ticks = isRawMode
    ? [domLo, (domLo + domHi) / 2, domHi]
    : [domLo, domLo / 2, 0, domHi / 2, domHi];
  const fmt = v => {
    const dp = (isPTOT && Math.abs(v) >= 10) ? 0 : 1;
    const sign = (!isRawMode && v > 0) ? "+" : "";
    return sign + v.toFixed(dp);
  };
  ticks.forEach(v => {
    const x = ((v - domLo) / (domHi - domLo || 1)) * rampW;
    legendG.append("text")
      .attr("x", x).attr("y", rampH + 12)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 9).attr("fill", "#333")
      .text(fmt(v));
  });
  legendG.append("text")
    .attr("x", rampW + 6).attr("y", rampH - 1)
    .attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", 500).attr("fill", "#555")
    .text(unit);
  legendG.append("text")
    .attr("x", 0).attr("y", -4)
    .attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", 600).attr("fill", "#333")
    .text(isRawMode
      ? `Ensemble-mean ${variable} (raw)`
      : `Ensemble-mean anomaly vs 1995–2014 baseline`);

  // Ring → period legend: a horizontal row of 5 nested-circle glyphs
  // showing the inner-to-outer ring order, each labelled with its
  // period. Sits below the colour ramp so the inside-the-clock text
  // labels (removed for legibility) are replaced by an explicit legend.
  const ringLegW = ringPeriods.length * 110;
  const ringLegX = (totalW - ringLegW) / 2;
  const ringLegY = legendY + rampH + 26;
  const ringLegG = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${ringLegX}, ${ringLegY})`);
  ringLegG.append("text")
    .attr("x", 0).attr("y", 0)
    .attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", 600).attr("fill", "#333")
    .text("Rings (inner → outer):");
  ringPeriods.forEach((period, i) => {
    const x = i * 110;
    const y = 18;
    // Tiny donut glyph — 5 concentric arcs with the current ring filled.
    const glyphR0 = 4, glyphRW = 2;
    const gArc = d3.arc();
    for (let ri = 0; ri < ringPeriods.length; ri++) {
      const innerR = glyphR0 + ri * glyphRW;
      ringLegG.append("path")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${x + 8}, ${y})`)
        .attr("d", gArc({ innerRadius: innerR, outerRadius: innerR + glyphRW,
                           startAngle: 0, endAngle: 2 * Math.PI }))
        .attr("fill", ri === i ? "#222" : "#ccc")
        .attr("stroke", "none");
    }
    ringLegG.append("text")
      .attr("x", x + 22).attr("y", y + 3)
      .attr("font-size", 9).attr("fill", "#333")
      .text(period);
  });

  // Reactive note shown when the user has picked more admin1s than the
  // grid renders. Goes above the SVG so it's noticed before the user
  // scrolls past, but below the section controls.
  const note = (overflow > 0)
    ? htl.html`<div style="font-size:11px;color:#7a4f00;background:#fff7e6;border:1px solid #f5d57e;border-radius:3px;padding:4px 10px;margin-bottom:8px;">
        Showing the first ${MAX_ROWS} of ${selAdmin1All.length} selected admin1s (alphabetical).
        Polar clocks get cramped beyond ${MAX_ROWS} rows × ${nCols} columns; narrow your admin1 selection
        in the global popup to see the others.
      </div>`
    : "";

  return chartDownloadMenu(
    htl.html`<div>${note}${svg.node()}</div>`,
    { filename: `period_polar_${scope}_${variable}_${sspsForRender.join("-")}` }
  );
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
  <p style="margin:0 0 4px;color:#444;">
    <strong>${globalScopeInfo.scope}</strong>
    · ${periodPolar_controls.variable}
    · ${(periodPolar_controls.ssp ?? ["ssp245"]).map(s => ({ ssp126:"SSP1-2.6", ssp245:"SSP2-4.5", ssp370:"SSP3-7.0", ssp585:"SSP5-8.5" })[s] ?? s).join(", ")}
    · ${periodPolar_controls.valueMode === "raw" ? "raw" : "anomaly vs 1995–2014"}
    · 12 rolling 3-month seasons × 5 reference windows
    · ${(globalScopeInfo.isCountry && (globalAdmin1 ?? []).length > 0) ? `${(globalAdmin1 ?? []).length} admin1 row${(globalAdmin1 ?? []).length === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "scope-mean row"}
  </p>
  <p style="margin:0;font-size:0.92em;color:#555;">
    Cell = ensemble-mean per (season, period) for the row's admin1 (or admin1-mean over scope
    when no admin1 selection is active). Wedges = 12 rolling 3-month seasons centred on each
    season's middle month (DJF at 12 o'clock, MAM at 3 o'clock, JJA at 6 o'clock, SON at 9 o'clock).
    Rings = chronological — 1995–2014 baseline innermost, 2081–2100 outermost. <strong>Anomaly
    palette is diverging blue → red</strong> (blue = below baseline, red = above) regardless of
    whether the variable is one-signed in this scope. <strong>Raw palette = Inferno</strong>
    (matches the observational P4 polar clock). Rolling 3-month seasons overlap (JFM, FMA, MAM
    all contain February) so the wedges are NOT independent samples — read the view as a
    seasonality fingerprint, not a sample comparison.
  </p>
`)
```

```{ojs}
quickInsightPeriodPolar = (() => {
  const t = nbText.sections.periodPolar.quickInsight;
  if (!periodPolar_data || !periodPolar_data.length) return _lang(t.loading);
  const { variable, ssp: sspSel, valueMode } = periodPolar_controls;
  const isRawMode = valueMode === "raw";
  const meanCol   = isRawMode ? "mean" : "mean_anomaly";
  const isPTOT = variable === "PTOT";
  const unit   = isPTOT ? "mm" : "°C";
  // Prose insight picks the highest-emission selected SSP for canonical
  // worst-case framing — same convention as Period ridges + Period table.
  const ssps   = Array.isArray(sspSel) && sspSel.length ? sspSel : ["ssp245"];
  const ssp    = ["ssp585","ssp370","ssp245","ssp126"].find(s => ssps.includes(s)) ?? ssps[0];
  const sspLab = ({ ssp126:"SSP1-2.6", ssp245:"SSP2-4.5", ssp370:"SSP3-7.0", ssp585:"SSP5-8.5" })[ssp] ?? ssp;
  // End-century season values for the prose insight.
  const late = "2081-2100";
  const rows = periodPolar_data.filter(d => d.scenario === ssp && d.period === late);
  if (!rows.length) return _lang(t.noData);
  const byS  = new Map();
  for (const d of rows) {
    const v = Number(d[meanCol]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(v)) continue;
    if (!byS.has(d.season)) byS.set(d.season, []);
    byS.get(d.season).push(v);
  }
  const seasonMeans = [...byS.entries()]
    .filter(([k]) => k !== "annual")
    .map(([k, vs]) => ({ k, m: d3.mean(vs) }))
    .filter(d => Number.isFinite(d.m));
  if (seasonMeans.length < 2) return _lang(t.noData);
  const peak = seasonMeans.reduce((a, b) => Math.abs(b.m) > Math.abs(a.m) ? b : a);
  const low  = seasonMeans.reduce((a, b) => Math.abs(b.m) < Math.abs(a.m) ? b : a);
  const range = d3.max(seasonMeans, d => d.m) - d3.min(seasonMeans, d => d.m);
  return Lang.reduceReplaceTemplateItems(_lang(t.ok), [
    { name: "ssp",        value: sspLab },
    { name: "variable",   value: variable },
    { name: "unit",       value: unit },
    { name: "peakSeason", value: peak.k },
    { name: "peakVal",    value: (peak.m >= 0 && !isRawMode ? "+" : "") + peak.m.toFixed(2) },
    { name: "lowSeason",  value: low.k },
    { name: "lowVal",     value: (low.m >= 0 && !isRawMode ? "+" : "") + low.m.toFixed(2) },
    { name: "range",      value: range.toFixed(2) },
  ]);
})();
```
